$comment: ADR-11 item 6 says every ::part() the MANIFEST declares must be present and targetable.
That is the right mechanism and #72-#74 inherit it — but today it is vacuous: the manifest
declares 0 cssParts, so a 'derived expected list' is a green assertion over nothing.
This file is the anti-vacuity guard. Adding a ::part() without updating it — and therefore
without a test — fails CI. Removing one is allowed and shrinks the count. Same shape as
check-manifest-content.mjs: derive from the source of truth, refuse to pass vacuously.
#72 is the first growth this ratchet has had to gate: <sk-card> declares part "card",
